purpose: Rebind the current committed infrastructure as a pre-distillation baseline and quarantine historical S5 and P22 capability assets from the rev3 production-completion path.

targets: historical S5 runtime and compiled policy
inputs: current production package and import graph
X.observation_scope: Repository metadata, committed source, tests, manifests, package boundaries, and pre-existing dirty-state inventory.
X.change_scope: Authority documents, PH-R00 governance artifacts, quarantine/import guards, dedicated tests, and evidence only.

relations: P16-P21 are infrastructure candidates rather than capability-completion proof
S5 and P22 compiled assets are historical or quarantine-only
the rev3 production path remains unavailable until an Owner-approved distilled initial-state bundle exists
expected_effects: the active strategy selector becomes PH-R00 then Track D, B, A, and E
historical policy assets cannot be selected as rev3 production parents or fallbacks
all baseline claims bind only to committed state
R.comparison: Compare the pre-change selector, phase bindings, package imports, and asset roles against the post-change rev3 manifests and executable guards.

Mc.boundary: No HDS distillation, Bridge compilation, AGI capability implementation, P22 optimization, locked-final access, or official submission.
acceptance: provided authority documents are retained with verified digests
current commit and tree are recorded
P16-P21 are classified as infrastructure candidates
S5, compiled policy, and P22/CV are classified as historical or quarantine
rev3 production selection fails closed without approved distilled assets
dedicated and required regressions are recorded
Mc.rollback: Revert only PH-R00-owned files to base commit 1eece1f21926be24c7c13608eb81f1d0a3f76614; preserve all pre-existing dirty artifacts.
Mc.completion: CODEX_SELF_AUDIT_PASS followed by OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED; Owner alone may set OWNER_APPROVED_PASS.

allowed_files: docs/roadmap/ARC3_HDS蒸留先行_開発ロードマップ_rev3.md
test_contract: type and lint checks for changed source
stop_condition: Stop at OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED, or SUSPEND if a required authority dependency remains unavailable.
